verses.text: For the music director. A song. A psalm. Shout with joy to God, all the earth!
Sing about the glory of his name! Praise him gloriously!
Say to God, "How amazing are the things you do! Your power is so great that your enemies bow down to you.
All the earth worships you and sings to you. They sing praises to your name." Selah.
Come and see what God has done, the amazing things he has done for people.
He turned the sea into dry land. They walked through the river on foot. There we celebrated because of him.
He rules forever by his power. His eyes watch the nations. Do not let rebels rise up against him. Selah.
Praise our God, all you nations! Let the sound of his praise be heard.
He keeps us alive and does not let our feet slip.
God, you tested us. You purified us like silver.
You brought us into prison and put heavy loads on our backs.
You let people ride over our heads. We went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of plenty.
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will keep the promises I made to you,
the promises my lips made and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.
I will offer you fat animals as burnt offerings, with the smoke of rams. I will offer bulls and goats. Selah.
Come and listen, all you who respect God. I will tell you what he has done for me.
I cried out to him with my mouth. His praise was on my tongue.
If I had held on to sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
But God has surely listened. He has heard my prayer.
Praise God! He has not turned away my prayer or taken his faithful love away from me.
